items.title: Nordson (NDSN) Lifts Dividend As Valuation Debate Turns On Whether Shares Are Fully Valued
items.summary: Nordson (NDSN) drew fresh investor attention after its board approved a 15% increase in the quarterly cash dividend to US$0.94 per share, with the higher payout scheduled for early October 2026. The dividend move comes on top of a strong run in Nordson’s stock, with the share price at US$318.36 and a year to date share price return of 32.08%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 43.33% points to momentum that has been building over a longer stretch. items.title: NDSN Q2 Deep Dive: Advanced Tech and Medical Segments Drive Upgraded Outlook
items.summary: Manufacturing company Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.3% year on year to $817.7 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.06 billion at the midpoint came in 2.4% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.25 per share was 5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
